svg.title: Wenyu Chiou: LLM evaluation & governed agents
svg.desc: Human evidence and context inform LLM proposals. Paired human and agent choices, working memory and an audit trail connect evaluation with governed action. A river basin with tributaries, rainfall, a stream gauge and households represents environmental feedback. Conceptual illustration, without measured results.
